scope: Import a sanitized rebuildable V0.2 source closure and implement faithful multi-GameLoader game-time reading for the four approved desktop shortcut identities.
forbidden: raw runtime configuration, user paths, role identity data, or compiled binaries
acceptance: Only 120古, 120靈, 大排, and 餐廳 desktop shortcuts define eligible GameLoader sources.
Displayed values come only from game-owned data, preserve observed precision, and never use Windows wall time, NTP, extrapolation, or fallback.
At least three same-generation samples form consensus; minute transitions resample all sources.
Equal values are grouped once, unequal values are all shown with source labels, and unreadable sources are listed separately.
The timer-action exception remains internal and cannot feed display, grouping, status, or other consumers.
Expensive discovery runs at no more than 0.2 Hz, steady reads and UI publishing at no more than 4 Hz per source, and unchanged values do not redraw.
API validation reflects the current application identity; packaging embeds only sanitized defaults and fails closed.
minimum_tests: direct shortcut selector and rate-limit tests
